findings.summary: Marten-GNN outperforms Pinecrest-Conv on Elmstead-Cite (84.7% vs 83.1%) and Harlow-Coauthor (92.6% vs 91.8%) in mean test accuracy, but Pinecrest-Conv has higher mean accuracy on Brack-Social (70.4% vs 69.8%) and Tiller-Protein (76.2% vs 75.5%).
findings.scope: Four node-classification graphs (Elmstead-Cite, Harlow-Coauthor, Brack-Social, Tiller-Protein), test accuracy (%), mean ± SD over 10 seeds.
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; differences in means only, so no significance claims.

findings.summary: Marten-GNN outperforms the feature-only MLP on all four graphs (e.g., 84.7% vs 74.2% on Elmstead-Cite, 92.6% vs 88.9% on Harlow-Coauthor, 69.8% vs 61.3% on Brack-Social, 75.5% vs 68.7% on Tiller-Protein).
findings.scope: Four node-classification graphs, test accuracy (%), mean ± SD over 10 seeds.
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; differences in means only.

findings.summary: The comparison between Marten-GNN and Pinecrest-Conv is mixed: Marten-GNN wins on two graphs, Pinecrest-Conv wins on two graphs, so the evidence does not support a claim that Marten-GNN generally outperforms Pinecrest-Conv across the four graphs.
findings.caveats: No statistical tests; results are per-graph means only.

sentences.text: Marten-GNN achieved higher mean test accuracy than Pinecrest-Conv on Elmstead-Cite (84.7% vs 83.1%) and Harlow-Coauthor (92.6% vs 91.8%), but Pinecrest-Conv achieved higher mean accuracy on Brack-Social (70.4% vs 69.8%) and Tiller-Protein (76.2% vs 75.5%).
Thus, the comparison is mixed across the four graphs, and the evidence does not support a claim that Marten-GNN generally outperforms Pinecrest-Conv on this benchmark.
Marten-GNN did, however, exceed the feature-only MLP on all four graphs (84.7% vs 74.2%, 92.6% vs 88.9%, 69.8% vs 61.3%, and 75.5% vs 68.7%, respectively).
No statistical tests were reported, so these differences are descriptive only.
